column3: The right pane's Files view becomes Drive (same view id `files`): a scope menu from drive.scopes for the active conversation, one folder per drive.list prefix with a breadcrumb instead of an expanding tree, the file viewer, editor, history, share, move and delete inside the pane, and a Drive row in the sidebar's nav
column4: The pane is 432 wide, so a nested tree beside a viewer would not fit; one folder at a time keeps each open to one indexed range scan and every op to one reload. Keeping the id `files` keeps stored tabs and the Overview arrow working. The sidebar nav is the one slot that is always visible; Overview already had a Drive section
